messages:
Alison: Heads-up — vendor X wants to onboard our secrets manager integration and needs our SCIM + SSO + KMS checklist. can we align on a minimal path to get them into the marketplace?
Ravi: I can cover KMS/HSM attestation and key-wrap compatibility. do we know if they require Bring-Your-Own-Key or customer-side HSM?
Diego: they said BYOK for enterprise customers but want an HA-managed option for marketplace customers. main ask: 'seamless rotation with Vault-style secret engines' and SCIM provisioning for service accounts.
Marta: timeline question — marketing wants a joint announcement two weeks after listing. that means engineering needs certs & docs ready in 10 business days. 
Ken: pinging product compliance: are there extra controls for the marketplace packaging? e.g., CCPA/DP controls, connectivity diagrams, and an audit artifact for HSM?
Ravi: we need to confirm FIPS/HSM models supported. Also will their attestation report (A․K․A vendor-signed cert) satisfy our security review? If not, we'll need an on-site or video attest.
Diego: quick technical note on SCIM: vendor's identity model uses group membership for service roles; they map roleName -> appRole in their SCIM. we should provide a sample mapping.
Diego: ```json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName": "svc-redwood", "externalId": "svc-1234", "groups": [{"value":"inference-ops","display":"Inference Ops"}], "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"costCenter":"partner-x"} }
```
Alison: nice. let's include that in the integration docs. Diego — can you also add a snippet for SAML metadata import for our console (users will upload IdP XML)?
Diego: yes, sample SAML metadata snippet to import (short):
Diego: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.partnerx.com">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>...certificate...</IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Marta: Ops question — marketplace listing needs a minimal runtime image with connector + config. ops-bot, is there a template we can reuse?
ops-bot: @Marta there is a marketplace connector template at https://console.internal/templates/marketplace-secrets-connector. Use tag rdx-marketplace-v1.
Ken: action items (rough): 1) Ravi: HSM attestation + BYOK flow doc (3d). 2) Diego: SCIM + SAML snippets + secrets adapter example (2d). 3) Alison: joint announcement cadence & PR draft (4d). 4) Marta: package template + runbook (5d).
Ravi: one edge-case: vendor's secret engine returns an opaque token for rotation webhook; we need a compatibility shim if they don't expose versioned secrets. can someone prototype a small adapter?
Diego: I'll prototype a shim that maintains version mapping and exponential backoff on rotates. pseudo:
Diego: ```python
# on rotate webhook: store opaque_id -> version
# fetch secret: call vendor.get(opaque_id, version_hint)
```
Alison: tradeoff call: do we ship shim in marketplace image or require partner to run it? product prefers partner-run for support reasons.
Marta: partner-run is fine if we can certify the container image and CI. otherwise we bundle as an optional compatibility layer.
Ken: legal/compliance also asked for retention policy + data flow diagram. Ravi, can you provide a minimal dataflow showing keys never leave HSM?
Ravi: yep — I'll draft a diagram and a short statement: keys generated/held in HSM, key material never exported, only wrapped keys stored in our DB.
Alison: final ask for this thread — can everyone ack their tasks by EOD so we can lock the dates for the announcement? @Diego @Ravi @Marta @Ken
Diego: ack, will start SCIM/SAML snippets today.
Ravi: ack, starting attestation doc.
Marta: ack, will adapt the marketplace template and confirm CI.
Ken: ack, will coordinate legal and marketing dependencies.
Alison: thanks — I'll draft the PR timeline and share a short checklist. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy note: created ticket INF-9472 (partner-x marketplace onboarding) assigned to Allison, Diego, Ravi, Marta, Ken. link: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-9472
Alison: perfect, closing this thread — we can move the checklist to the ticket and run a 15-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:
